title: Comparing Entering Receivables Transactions in Dynamics SL to Dynamics 365 Business Central

chapters.title: Entering invoice and credit memo in Dynamics SL
Applying credit memo to invoice in Dynamics SL
Entering sales invoice in Business Central
Entering and applying credit memo in Business Central

features.name: Sales invoice entry in Business Central
features.description: Enter a single customer invoice using the sales invoice screen by navigating from the role center, selecting the customer, and entering line items for various options including items and services in a single invoice.

features.name: Sales credit memo entry in Business Central
features.description: Enter a credit memo in the sales credit memo screen and apply it to a specific invoice using the applies to doc type and applies to doc number fields in one entry, eliminating the need for separate payment application steps.
caveats: Allows application in one entry versus separate payment application step

features.name: Preview posting in Business Central
features.description: Verify posting entries prior to the posting process by selecting post and then preview posting to confirm entries are being applied correctly.

features.name: Sales journal alternative entry method
features.description: Enter multiple entries for multiple customers using the sales journal from the role center, which provides an alternative to entering single customer invoices through the sales invoice screen.
